brief:
Britain's Foreign Minister Ed Miliband announced a ban on importing goods produced in Israeli West Bank settlements, characterizing the move as a "comprehensive reset" of UK policy toward Israel, Al Jazeera English reported. The ban applies to products manufactured in settlements, which international law considers illegal under occupation.

Miliband framed the policy shift as part of Britain's broader reorientation on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The announcement represents a departure from previous UK positions on settlement goods, following sustained pressure from lawmakers and rights groups over trade with occupied territories.
dek: Foreign Minister Ed Miliband said the ban represents a 'comprehensive reset' of the UK's policy on Israel.
title: UK bans goods from Israeli West Bank settlements
